items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Whose place did you take? A fellow by the name of Cuckoo. It's called Cuckoo. Oh, Elmore Chalvin. Brother-in-law.

ctx.x: How many trumpets did they have at that time? Well, I was the only one I worked with. I know I was a tiny band because I was split up like that. Take me in, you know. Oh, I see. Like my plans. Whose place did you take? A fellow by the name of Cuckoo. It's called Cuckoo. Oh, Elmore Chalvin. Brother-in-law. Yeah, I'm a tower, I'm a tower. Oh, yeah. He's brother-in-law. Brother-in-law, yeah. To Deep Pass. And I take my place. Oh, I see. Oh, yeah. I have one.
And how long did you stay with the bass?
